title: jackson-databind polymorphic deserialization on provisioning-api-02
description: jackson-databind 2.8.8 is on the classpath of the provisioning API. Public exploits exist for gadget chains. The service never enables default typing: ObjectMapper is built in ProvisioningJson.java with activateDefaultTyping absent and no @JsonTypeInfo annotation in the code base (see code-search.txt).
